payload.title: ad-hoc-delegation live proof used host models
payload.body: claude -p (stance-judge.sh) cannot reach the API on this host (ENOTFOUND, all 6 before-runs dark), so LIVE JUDGE and COLD READ ran through the worker's STANCE_EMIT_PAYLOAD/STANCE_VERDICT_FILE seam with the host completion models (smol for the judge; slow and smol for the cold read), not haiku/opus-5-5. Before: P1 denied 3/3, P2 denied 3/3. After: P1 allowed 3/3, P2 denied 3/3. Cold read: (a) YES in 23 of 24 reads (one kino smol NO contradicting its own quote), (b)-(d) NO, (e) planner in all. Rerun on a networked host with the named models if that exact model pair matters. Evidence: /tmp/loop-ledger-cold-read/ad-hoc-delegation/
